why: The shape the file had before issue #531: the entrance trigger recomputing the roundStartTick comparison locally instead of reading the one `snap` the sync already resolved. The two agreed for as long as `snap` was that comparison, which is exactly why the duplication survived review; the moment `snap` also carries the level-switch announcement, the local copy silently keeps the broken half. The visible result is a player who gets no entrance effect at all on the one transition that reaches a new board without a death first, and one on every other. Nothing else in the file notices: the round-restart trigger it was written for still fires.
killedBy: spawn animation (#199) starts the entrance on an announced level switch, whose worlds agree on roundStartTick (#531)
